title: The Effect of Security-Focused Prompts on Reported Findings: A Controlled Experiment on 400 AI-Generated Web Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.28408v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic coding tools turn a specification into a running web application, so their defaults for authentication, sessions, input validation, and dependencies become its security posture. This study asks whether appending a fixed block of OWASP-aligned security requirements to the prompt changes what such tools produce, by how much, and with what side effects. Each of 100 frozen specifications was realized four times: two agentic tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI) crossed with two prompts sharing a byte-identical functional core, without (A) and with (B) the security block. A fixed static and dynamic pipeline scanned the 400 applications, yielding 6,721 triaged findings, analyzed with count and logistic mixed models and with a dependency diff. The block cut findings per application by a third (incidence-rate ratio 0.65, 95% CI 0.60-0.71), equally through both tools, and roughly doubled the declared dependency surface, so variant-B applications

translated_title: 以安全为导向的提示词对所报告发现的影响：一项针对400个AI生成Web应用的对照实验
translated_abstract: 智能体编程工具能够将规格说明转化为可运行的Web应用，因此其在身份验证、会话、输入验证和依赖项方面的默认行为便决定了该应用的安全态势。本研究探讨在提示词末尾附加一段固定的、与OWASP对齐的安全需求是否会改变这类工具的产出、改变幅度有多大，以及会带来哪些副作用。100个冻结的规格说明各自被实现四次：由两种智能体工具（Claude Code、Codex CLI）与两个共享字节级相同功能核心的提示词版本交叉组合——不带（A）与带（B）安全模块。一套固定的静态与动态扫描流水线对这400个应用进行了扫描，产出6,721条经分诊的发现，并通过计数与逻辑混合模型以及依赖项差异分析进行处理。该安全模块将每个应用的安全发现减少了三分之一（发病率比0.65，95% CI 0.60–0.71），且对两种工具效果一致，同时使声明依赖面大约扩大了一倍，因此变体B的应用……
tldr: 一项针对400个AI生成Web应用的对照实验表明，在提示词中加入与OWASP对齐的安全需求模块可将每个应用的漏洞发现减少约三分之一，但代价是使声明依赖面大约扩大了一倍。
en_tdlr: A controlled experiment on 400 AI-generated web applications shows that appending an OWASP-aligned security block to prompts cuts reported findings per app by a third across both agentic tools, at the cost of roughly doubling the declared dependency surface.
